design_probes.design_claim: The official v013 config produces both command-conditioned Reward branches and carries real MuJoCo Reward through production replay into finite privileged SAC updates.
design_probes.necessary_capability: Compose the official Hydra profile and G1WalkFlat MuJoCo environment, activate zero/nonzero command branches, preserve Reward identity in ReplayBuffer, and consume both modes in production SAC updates.
design_probes.minimal_case: 32 real MuJoCo rows, one zero-action control transition, 128 replay samples, one Critic update, and one Actor update.
design_probes.falsifier: Wrong 98/303/29 identity, absent stand or walk rows, missing mode telemetry, non-finite Reward, replay Reward mismatch, non-finite update, or unchanged Actor.
design_probes.success_witness: The route receipt records 9 stand rows, 23 walk rows, 128 reward-identical samples, six finite Critic metrics, four finite Actor metrics, and an Actor parameter delta.

design_probes.design_claim: The v013 effective Reward/config identity is sealed into strict full-state checkpoints and one exact 20+1 Oracle lineage.
design_probes.necessary_capability: Round-trip full learner state before mutation and finalize iterations 240 through 4800 plus 5000 through the production gateway.
design_probes.minimal_case: One full model_240 state save/reload and 21 tiny-payload lifecycle saves through the bound gateway.
simplifications: tiny state payload for remaining lineage files
design_probes.falsifier: Post-validation mutation, failed exact restoration, config identity mismatch, missing/extra/mixed checkpoint, or wrong final iteration.
design_probes.success_witness: A deliberately mutated Actor restores exactly and one manifest records 21 checkpoint hashes with final_iteration 5000.

design_probes.design_claim: The production server collector and CUDA learner can carry the admitted v013 identities through the first live update.
design_probes.necessary_capability: Complete one MuJoCo collector subprocess to CPU-pinned double-buffer to CUDA learner transaction with both command modes represented.
design_probes.minimal_case: 32 environments and the first finite live update, bounded by 120 seconds.
design_probes.falsifier: Any collector, branch, tensor, transfer, CUDA, child-lifecycle, numeric, or write-boundary failure.
design_probes.success_witness: One logged finite CUDA learner update whose collected batch contains both stand and walk rows under the v013 identity.

live_only_unknowns.fact: On the server, the official v013 MuJoCo collector, CPU-pinned double buffer, and CUDA learner complete the first finite privileged SAC update while carrying both stand and walk rows.
live_only_unknowns.why_offline_impossible: The local machine has no server CUDA device and the R1 test directly fills ReplayBuffer rather than starting the production collector subprocess; it cannot prove CUDA compilation, pinned transfer, child lifecycle, or first live update.
live_only_unknowns.falsifier: Collector startup failure, missing stand/walk row, wrong 98/303/29 tensors, pinned-transfer failure, non-finite first metrics, child death, or write outside the fresh audit directory.
live_only_unknowns.cost: One server GPU, 32 MuJoCo environments, a fresh isolated directory, and at most 120 seconds; stop after the first finite update or first invariant failure.
live_only_unknowns.stop_condition: Stop immediately after the first finite collector-to-CUDA-learner update, at 120 seconds, or on the first identity, lifecycle, branch, or numeric failure; never continue the Oracle campaign.
live_only_unknowns.bounded_command: cd /ssd1/cyx/ICE-Cal && AUDIT_DIR=$(mktemp -d /ssd1/cyx/ICE-Cal/.v013-formal-XXXXXX) && timeout 120s env CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 ICE_CAL_ORACLE_LINEAGE_ID=formal-live-v013 PYTHONPATH=/ssd1/cyx/ICE-Cal/src uv run --no-sync python scripts/train_offpolicy.py algo=sac task=sac/g1_walk_flat/mujoco_fada_privileged_oracle training.device=cuda:0 training.log_dir=$AUDIT_DIR algo.num_envs=32 algo.batch_size=32 algo.learning_starts=1 algo.max_iterations=5000
live_only_unknowns.zero_write_boundary: Only the newly created /ssd1/cyx/ICE-Cal/.v013-formal-* directory may be written; no existing checkpoint, log, config, source, or repository file may change.

claims.scope: The official local v013 config and real MuJoCo Reward compose through production ReplayBuffer into one finite privileged SAC Critic and Actor update with both command modes represented.
The v013 resolved config identity strictly round-trips full state and the production gateway finalizes one exact 20+1 lineage.

negative_scope: No server CUDA collector transaction, long training, convergence, locomotion quality, Unit B readiness, commit, push, or deployment is claimed.
LIVE_REQUIRED is not permission to start the bounded server command without server access and confirmation of the target session.
Local R1/R2 PASS does not prove 5000-iteration stability or privileged Oracle policy quality.
